# Welcome!

I am a quantitative ecologist with expertise in remote sensing and big data, focused on monitoring natural disturbance, ecosystem dynamics, and cross-ecosystem disturbance interactions. I develop and apply computational and spatial analytical tools to track landscape change at scale, uncovering the drivers and consequences of disturbance across ecosystems.

Currently, I am a postdoctoral research fellow in the Geomatics Spatio-Temporal Analysis & Remote Sensing Lab @ Carleton University.
